about_short_description.short_description: CoProvider is a Dubai-based B2B marketplace and RFQ platform.

product.name: Online B2B Marketplace Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform connecting buyers and sellers in SMEs and corporates to facilitate service procurement and sales through requests for quotations (RFQs).

product.name: Procurement as a Service (PaaS)
product.description: A service enabling procurement professionals to extend their expertise to companies, facilitating more efficient buying and governance of procurement agreements.

product.name: Facility Management Services Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace segment offering various facility management services including cleaning, HVAC, MEP, fire and safety, pest control, and preventive maintenance.

product.name: IT and Digital Services Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace segment for IT and digital services including website and mobile app development, software development, digital marketing, and e-commerce solutions.

product.name: Logistics and Warehouse Services Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace segment providing logistics-related services including clearing agents, forwarding, movers and packers, warehouse storage, courier services, and container rental or sale.

product.name: Industrial and Engineering Services Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace segment offering industrial equipment installation, field maintenance, testing and inspection, laboratory services, and energy optimization.
